snippet.title: INHERITED SHADOWS | Midsummer Night's Scream: A HORROR GAME AWARDS SHOWCASE 2026
snippet.description:
Inherited Shadows is an upcoming psychological survival horror game inspired by the classics of the genre. Play as Amanda, a young woman haunted by her mother's abandonment as she explores a remote and nightmarish place filled with terrifying creatures, twisted secrets and psychological tension. Manage Amanda’s fear, solve puzzles and survive horrifying encounters in a dark atmospheric experience with fixed camera angles.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2939450/Inherited_Shadows/
---
Originally aired during MIDSUMMER NIGHT'S SCREAM: a Horror Game Awards Showcase on Monday 1 June 2026.
---
Set up by two die hard horror game fans, the aim of The Horror Game Awards is simple: to celebrate horror as one of the best genres in video games and to recognise the year’s greatest horror games alongside the developers who make them.
